{{Current events|year=2019|month=09|day=5|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflict and attacks
*[[September 2019 Kabul bombings]]
**A [[Taliban]] bomb in the middle of a heavily fortified area in [[Kabul]] kills twelve people, including a [[United States Army|U.S. soldier]] and a [[Romanian Armed Forces|Romanian soldier]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2019/09/05/politics/afghanistan-us-service-member/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-49592971 (BBC)]

;Business and economy
*[[Walgreens]] and [[CVS Pharmacy|CVS]] ask customers not to bring guns into their stores in response to several deadly [[mass shooting]]s last month. [https://www.cnn.com/2019/09/05/business/walgreens-open-carry/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Economy of Mexico]]
**Mexican authorities are preparing the launch of a [[United States dollar|$]]1 billion per year oil [[hedge (finance)|hedging]] program, and [[options trading]] consistent with such a giant trade. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mexico-oil-hedge-exclusive/exclusive-mexico-moves-to-launch-worlds-largest-oil-hedge-program-sources-idUSKCN1VQ2E1 (Reuters)] 
;Disasters and accidents
*[[2019 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**[[Hurricane Dorian]] spawns several tornadoes in [[the Carolinas]] and causes power outages to 230,000 people in [[South Carolina]]. [https://www.charlotteobserver.com/news/weather-news/article234733197.html (''Charlotte Observer'')] [https://www.washingtonexaminer.com/news/hurricane-dorian-hurls-tornadoes-at-carolinas (''Washington Examiner'')]
*[[Air France Flight 447]]
**A [[France|French]] magistrates' court drops 228 charges of manslaughter brought by victims' relatives against [[Airbus]] and [[Air France]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-49598838 (BBC)]
*The [[National Transportation Safety Board]] of the [[United States]] rules that driver inattention and the design of [[Tesla, Inc.|Tesla]]'s [[tesla Autopilot|Autopilot]] feature were jointly the cause of a 2018 crash. A separate fatal Tesla crash remains subject to investigation by the Board. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/technology-49594260 (BBC)]
;International relations
*A [[United States Department of State]] spokesperson confirms as accurate a story reported yesterday by the ''[[Financial Times]]'', saying that [[Akhilesh Kumar]], the captain of a tanker carrying [[Iran]]ian oil that was captured in [[Gibraltar]] in July and since then released, was offered millions of dollars by U.S. official [[Brian Hook]] to change its course, so that it could be impounded on U.S. charges of "terrorism". [https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-offered-money-to-indian-ship-captain-iran-calls-it-blackmail/story-mvVz2awHrVYWU1dGgf537K.html (''Hindustan Times'')]
;Law and crime
*The [[San Francisco Board of Supervisors]] passes an official resolution declaring the [[National Rifle Association]] to be a [[domestic terrorism in the United States|domestic terrorist]] organization. NRA chief executive [[Wayne LaPierre]] criticizes the decision online. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2019-09-05/san-francisco-declares-nra-a-terrorist-organisation/11483440 (ABC)]
*The Court of Appeal in [[Kyiv]], [[Ukraine]], rules to release Volodymyr Tsemakh, a person of interest in the case of the downed [[Malaysia Airlines Flight 17]]. [[President of Russia]] [[Vladimir Putin]] says both countries are finalizing negotiations on a "rather large-scale" [[prisoner exchange]]. [https://www.rferl.org/a/mh17-suspect-to-be-released/30147814.html (RFE/RL)]
*[[Ghost Ship warehouse fire]]
**A jury finds Max Harris, the creative director of the Ghost Ship warehouse in [[Oakland, California]], not guilty on [[involuntary manslaughter]] charges in relation to a fire at the location in 2016, which killed 36 people. The jury fails to reach a verdict on similar charges for its leaseholder, Derick Almena, due to a [[hung jury]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2019/09/05/us/ghost-ship-fire-oakland-verdict/index.html?utm_source=CNN-News-Alerts&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=verdict+in+Ghost+Ship+fire+deaths057346f4-7cdc-4be7-9889-3e43be6d702a&utm_term=1c1a3674-f347-0441-0baa-8ee61c704e63&m=d6b08d327e4dcaf19c8d7624ea3f3e1e&p=2019-09-0522:31 (CNN)]
*Former [[First Lady of Honduras]] [[Rosa Elena Bonilla]] is sentenced to 58 years in prison after buying jewels with public funds. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-49593150 (BBC)]
;Politics and elections
*[[Jo Johnson]], [[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|British Prime Minister]] [[Boris Johnson]]'s younger brother, resigns from his joint position as the minister of state for universities, science, research and innovation with the [[Department of Education]] and the [[Department for Business, Energy and Industrial Strategy]]. He says he has experienced "an unresolvable tension" in recent weeks in being "torn between family loyalty and the national interest". [https://www.nbcnews.com/storyline/brexit-referendum/u-k-prime-minister-boris-johnson-s-brother-quits-government-n1049886 (NBC News)]
*[[Conte II Cabinet]], [[2019 Italian government crisis]]
**[[Prime Minister of Italy|Italian Prime Minister]] [[Giuseppe Conte]]'s new cabinet is sworn in after the [[coalition government|coalition]] agreement between the [[Five Star Movement]] and the [[Democratic Party (Italy)|Democratic Party]]. [[Lega Nord]] ministers, led by [[Matteo Salvini]], are ousted from the government. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/sep/05/italys-coalition-enemies-open-way-matteo-salvini-return (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Turkish President]] [[Recep Tayyip Erdoğan]] threatens to "open the gates" and allow over three million [[Syrian refugee]]s to freely emigrate into Europe, unless the [[Northern Syria Buffer Zone]], agreed [[Turkey–United States relations|between Turkey and the United States]], is set up according to Turkey's plans. He further claims that the "international community, namely the [[European Union]]" fails to provide support with respect to the refugees. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/sep/05/erdogan-ill-let-syrian-refugees-leave-turkey-for-west-unless-safe-zone-set-up (''The Guardian'')]
*Special Representative for International Negotiations [[Jason Greenblatt]], in charge of crafting the as yet unreleased [[Trump peace plan]] intended to resolve the [[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]], announces his resignation.  [https://edition.cnn.com/2019/09/05/politics/jason-greenblatt-mideast-peace-trump/index.html (CNN)]
<!-- All news items above this line -->}}
